mapper.select: SELECT cf.finance_cost_id FROM ( SELECT cfc.finance_cost_id FROM gld_lon_contract_fin_cost cfc WHERE cfc.withdraw_id=#{withdrawId} ORDER BY cfc.period_name DESC) cf WHERE rownum=1
SELECT nvl(sum(finance_income_includ),0) FROM gld_lon_contract_fin_cost glcfc WHERE glcfc.withdraw_id=#{withdrawId} AND glcfc.finance_cost_id!=#{financeCostId}

select glcf.finance_cost_id, (SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id) bp_name, glcf.company_id, lc.contract_number, lcw.withdraw_number, lcw.due_amount, lcw.withdraw_currency_code, (select fc.currency_name from fnd_currency fc where fc.currency_code = lcw.withdraw_currency_code) currency, lcw.due_date, glcf.start_date, glcf.end_date, glcf.finance_cost, glcf.post_flag, glcf.period_name, lc.contract_id, lcw.withdraw_id from gld_lon_contract_fin_cost glcf left join lon_contract lc on lc.contract_id = glcf.contract_id left join lon_contract_withdraw lcw on lcw.withdraw_id = glcf.withdraw_id
1 = 1
and (glcf.period_name = #{periodName} or (glcf.period_name < #{periodName} and glcf.post_flag = 'N'))
and glcf.post_flag = #{postFlag}
and (SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id) like concat('%', concat(#{bpName}, '%'))
and lc.contract_number like concat('%', concat(#{contractNumber} ,'%'))
and lcw.withdraw_number like concat('%', concat(#{withdrawNumber}, '%'))
